goal: Add src/csv.js exporting parseCsv(text) and stringifyCsv(rows, columns). parseCsv reads RFC 4180 style CSV with a header row into an array of objects of strings: quoted fields may contain commas, doubled quotes ("") and newlines, and both LF and CRLF line ends and a missing final newline are accepted; empty input gives []. stringifyCsv writes a header (columns default to the keys of the first row) and one line per row, quoting fields that contain a comma, quote or newline, with LF line ends and a trailing newline; no rows and no columns gives "". parseCsv(stringifyCsv(rows)) must round-trip.
